section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section describes the methodology for a study conducted in Greater London, United Kingdom, where participants were recruited opportunistically from public locations and completed a paper-and-pencil survey. The study obtained ethics approval, used semi-randomized scale presentation with demographics last, and participants provided written informed consent without remuneration.
